name: Celebrity Gogglebox
description: A rolling cast of famous faces, some of Britain's best loved personalities, turn their hand to being the country's most opinionated viewers, sharing their opinions on what they have been watching during the week.

videos.title: Best of 2019
videos.overview: Some of the best moments from 2019, featuring Martin and Roman Kemp, Rylan Clark-Neal and his mum Linda, Nick and Liv Grimshaw, Chris Eubank Sr and his son Chris Eubank Jr, Oti, Motsi and Phemelo Mabuse, Gyles Brandreth and Sheila Hancock, and Martin and Roman Kemp. Among the shows under review are "Love Island, Naked Attraction, Killing Eve and First Dates', as well as the films 'Titanic" and 'American Pie.

videos.title: Best of 2020
videos.overview: A chance to catch-up with some of the best moments from this year's episodes, featuring some of the country's favourite celebrities. The line-up critiquing the year's biggest and best shows include Denise van Outen and her partner Eddie, Rylan Clark-Neal and his mum Linda, Gyles Brandreth and Maureen Lipman, Mo Gilligan and Babatunde Aleshe, KSI and S-X, and Shaun Ryder and Bez.

videos.title: Best of 2021
videos.overview: The celebs hit the couch for some of 2021's best TV - from Maureen Lipman and Bez to Mo Gilligan and Tom Jones. The shows include Masked Dancer, First Dates, Quizness, Extreme Sisters and Sex / Life.

videos.title: Best of 2022
videos.overview: Retrospective edition, recalling series highlights from 2022. The line-up of famous faces critiquing the year's biggest and best shows to date includes Rylan, Gyles Brandreth, Joanna Lumley, Tom Allen, Rob Beckett, Mo Gilligan, Babatunde Aleshe, Denise Van Outen, Duncan James, Sophie Ellis-Bextor, Zoe Ball, Shaun Ryder and Bez. Shows being appraised include Love Island, Platinum Party at the Palace, The Savoy, Spooked Scotland, Saturday Night Fever, Who Wants to Be a Millionaire - Soccer Aid Special, and Big Boys.

videos.title: Best of 2024
videos.overview: A look back over the standout moments from Series 6, when the celebs watched Bridgerton, MILF Manor, Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders, and Donald Trump's victory in the US presidential election.
